propositions: The bridge noun with preview and sync subcommands must ship functional and non-breaking alongside all legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor).
bridge preview enforces read-only dry-run path with no Jira or ticket-store mutation; bridge sync enforces live path with mutation.
Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode round-trip behavior in mode.py must remain intact and functional.
Nested bridge subcommand dispatch must be explicit; no sibling verb is advertised before functional implementation lands.
User guide, CLI reference, and release notes must document only the staged surface (preview and sync) that actually ships.
Legacy consumers and in-repo workflows must remain fully functional at story boundary with no breaking changes to environment contracts or library callers.
